name: Chef's Doner
about: Döner, İskender kebab, and kumpir on Gallows Road. A Dunn Loring food truck that customers praise for flavorful beef, fresh bread, and friendly service.

reviews.author: Arnold
reviews.text: This is a great food truck around the corner from my work!

reviews.author: Elaheh M.
reviews.text: We had the İskender kebab and the Berlin-style beef döner, and both were incredible.

reviews.author: Aymen M.
reviews.text: The beef was flavorful and the bread was fresh and honestly one of my favorite parts.

reviews.author: Akmal B.
reviews.text: One of the best places to get kumpir in the area.
